description: Post-compromise forensics: Ubuntu 22.04 host with an exposed Docker API abused to launch a container, escape to the host, drop a cryptominer, and install cron and systemd persistence.
scenario: An Ubuntu 22.04 host exposed the Docker Engine API on 0.0.0.0:2375 with no TLS. The attacker started a privileged container mounting the host filesystem, escaped to the host, dropped a cryptominer, and installed cron and systemd persistence. Alerts surface the miner and the cron job; the systemd unit and the attacker container's entrypoint residue are silent.

remediation.action: firewall the Docker API port and block the attacker IP
quarantine the xmrig miner and terminate the process
disable and remove the docker-metrics systemd unit
remediation.verify: systemctl is-enabled docker-metrics returns not enabled

remediation.action: stop and remove the attacker container and image
remediation.verify: docker ps -a shows no attacker container

remediation.action: disable the TCP Docker socket; require TLS/localhost only
rotate credentials and secrets reachable from the host and containers
restart Docker with the hardened config and confirm host health
remediation.verify: systemctl is-active docker and CPU baseline normal
